interpretation: All four original time grids and all17original vectors reproduce exactly with the added native internal probes. Tight-charge aborts retain finite, smoothly varying qbe/qbc and vbe/vbc at the final accepted points, with extremely small timesteps and noisy dynamic currents. This does not identify the rejected Newton state or prove absence of discontinuities elsewhere. Neither abort occurs exactly at a recorded source knot. Test intermediate charge tolerances on the coupled circuit before attributing the failure to the PDK or removing original startup gates.
